_comment: Non-secret configuration that ships INSIDE the container image. appsettings.json is gitignored because it holds credentials, so it is absent from the Docker build context and from production — anything defined only there is missing at runtime. Non-secret defaults therefore belong in this file. Precedence: this file, then appsettings.json (local dev only), then environment variables.
_templates: TemplateIdMap keys are the internal template keys producers send; values are Brevo numeric template IDs. Every key here must have a contract registered in TemplateContractRegistry and vice versa — TemplateConfigurationValidator enforces both at startup. See docs/email-templates.md.

QueueReliability._comment: MaxMessageAgeHours is deliberately short. Mail older than this is not sent — it gets a 'rejected' delivery-log row prefixed 'Stale: ' and is archived off the queue. A consumer outage longer than this discards real notifications by design.
